entries.title: Jeremiah 30:1
segments: The word that came to Jeremiah from Jehovah, saying,

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:2
segments: Thus speaketh Jehovah, the God of Israel, saying, Write thee all the words that I have spoken unto thee in a book.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:3
segments: For, lo, the days come, saith Jehovah, that I will turn again the captivity of my people Israel and Judah, saith Jehovah; and I will cause them to return to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they shall possess it.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:4
segments: And these are the words that Jehovah spake concerning Israel and concerning Judah.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:5
segments: For thus saith Jehovah: We have heard a voice of trembling, of fear, and not of peace.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:6
segments: Ask ye now, and see whether a man doth travail with child: wherefore do I see every man with his hands on his loins, as a woman in travail, and all faces are turned into paleness?

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:7
segments: Alas! for that day is great, so that none is like it: it is even the time of Jacob's trouble; but he shall be saved out of it.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:8
segments: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith Jehovah of hosts, that I will break his yoke from off thy neck, and will burst thy bonds; and strangers shall no more make him their bondman;

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:9
segments: but they shall serve Jehovah their God, and David their king, whom I will raise up unto them.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:10
segments: Therefore fear thou not, O Jacob my servant, saith Jehovah; neither be dismayed, O Israel: for, lo, I will save thee from afar, and thy seed from the land of their captivity; and Jacob shall return, and shall be quiet and at ease, and none shall make him afraid.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:11
segments: For I am with thee, saith Jehovah, to save thee: for I will make a full end of all the nations whither I have scattered thee, but I will not make a full end of thee; but I will correct thee in measure, and will in no wise leave thee unpunished.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:12
segments: For thus saith Jehovah, Thy hurt is incurable, and thy wound grievous.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:13
segments: There is none to plead thy cause, that thou mayest be bound up: thou hast no healing medicines.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:14
segments: All thy lovers have forgotten thee; they seek thee not: for I have wounded thee with the wound of an enemy, with the chastisement of a cruel one, for the greatness of thine iniquity, because thy sins were increased.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:15
segments: Why criest thou for thy hurt? thy pain is incurable: for the greatness of thine iniquity, because thy sins were increased, I have done these things unto thee.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:16
segments: Therefore all they that devour thee shall be devoured; and all thine adversaries, every one of them, shall go into captivity; and they that despoil thee shall be a spoil, and all that prey upon thee will I give for a prey.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:17
segments: For I will restore health unto thee, and I will heal thee of thy wounds, saith Jehovah; because they have called thee an outcast, [saying], It is Zion, whom no man seeketh after.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:18
segments: Thus saith Jehovah: Behold, I will turn again the captivity of Jacob's tents, and have compassion on his dwelling-places; and the city shall be builded upon its own hill, and the palace shall be inhabited after its own manner.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:19
segments: And out of them shall proceed thanksgiving and the voice of them that make merry: and I will multiply them, and they shall not be few; I will also glorify them, and they shall not be small.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:20
segments: Their children also shall be as aforetime, and their congregation shall be established before me; and I will punish all that oppress them.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:21
segments: And their prince shall be of themselves, and their ruler shall proceed from the midst of them; and I will cause him to draw near, and he shall approach unto me: for who is he that hath had boldness to approach unto me? saith Jehovah.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:22
segments: And ye shall be my people, and I will be your God.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:23
segments: Behold, the tempest of Jehovah, [even his] wrath, is gone forth, a sweeping tempest: it shall burst upon the head of the wicked.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:24
segments: The fierce anger of Jehovah shall not return, until he have executed, and till he have performed the intents of his heart: in the latter days ye shall understand it.
